
## 2. Every flagged (file, token) pair — what must disappear

T19 scans 8 files: the 2 skeletons plus `kaola-workflow-{next,finalize}/SKILL.md` in each of the 3
codex editions. I enumerated, over that exact scope, every (file, token) pair matching
case-INSENSITIVELY but not case-sensitively. That delta is precisely the set of new detections.

**Delta = 4 pairs, all of them token #7 `'profile freshness gate'`:**

| file | token | shipped text |
|---|---|---|
| `templates/routing/next.skeleton.md` | `profile freshness gate` | `:237` `<!-- REGION:skill — it defers to the Codex Profile Freshness Gate above as the authority on profile availability, and that gate renders on this surface only -->` |
| `templates/routing/next.skeleton.md` | `profile freshness gate` | `:245` `about tool availability, not a choice to present as a question. The Codex Profile Freshness Gate` |
| `plugins/kaola-workflow/skills/kaola-workflow-next/SKILL.md` | `profile freshness gate` | `:257` `about tool availability, not a choice to present as a question. The Codex Profile Freshness Gate` |
| `plugins/kaola-workflow-gitlab/skills/kaola-workflow-next/SKILL.md` | `profile freshness gate` | `:257` (same rendered line) |
| `plugins/kaola-workflow-gitea/skills/kaola-workflow-next/SKILL.md` | `profile freshness gate` | `:257` (same rendered line) |

Note the skeleton carries **two** occurrences (the `REGION:skill` comment at `:237` and the prose at
`:245-246`); the three rendered `SKILL.md` files carry only the prose one, since the region comment
is not rendered. The prose sentence continues on `:246-247` (`above is authoritative for profile
availability; profile drift is not tool unavailability and must not be recorded as one.`).

**Clean, and expected to stay clean:** `templates/routing/finalize.skeleton.md` and all three
`kaola-workflow-finalize/SKILL.md`.

Zero of the other eight tokens produced any match, case-sensitive or case-insensitive, on any of the

```
scanned 8 files; new case-insensitive detections: 4
```

Every new detection is token #7. The identifier-shaped tokens (`<!-- PIN: codex-profile-preflight -->`,

## 4. Mutation proofs (scratch mirror, real file never mutated)

Built a scratch mirror: a directory whose top-level entries are symlinks to the real repo, with a
real `scripts/` dir of symlinks in which only `test-route-reachability.js` is a mutable copy. The
unmutated mirror reproduced the red exactly (4 failures / 327 passed / exit 1). Three variants:

**V1 — control: revert the predicate to case-sensitive.**
```
Route-reachability test passed (331 assertions).
V1-EXIT=0
```
My one-line change is the sole cause of the red, and the stated 331/exit-0 baseline reproduces byte
for byte. The red is load-bearing.

**V2 — the existing mutation proof re-run with each appended token UPPERCASED**
(`recurringGateAbsent(\`${content}\n${token.toUpperCase()}\n\`)`):
```
Route-reachability test FAILED: 4 failure(s), 327 passed.
V2-EXIT=1
```
Identical to the unmutated run: the same 4 boundary failures and **zero** mutation-assertion
failures. All 8 files x 9 tokens = 72 mutation assertions still red the check when the injected
token arrives in a different case. Case-insensitivity is live for **every one** of the nine tokens
on **every** scanned file, not only for the one that happens to survive in prose.

**V3 — neutralize the predicate (`recurringGateAbsent = true`), to prove the mutation loop is armed
rather than vacuous:**
```
FAIL: T19 install-boundary mutation: adding "<!-- PIN: codex-profile-preflight -->" reds templates/routing/next.skeleton.md
FAIL: T19 install-boundary mutation: adding "profile_preflight_refused" reds templates/routing/next.skeleton.md
FAIL: T19 install-boundary mutation: adding "--no-autofix" reds templates/routing/next.skeleton.md
FAIL: T19 install-boundary mutation: adding "kaola-workflow-codex-preflight.js" reds templates/routing/next.skeleton.md
FAIL: T19 install-boundary mutation: adding "KAOLA_CODEX_PREFLIGHT" reds templates/routing/next.skeleton.md
FAIL: T19 install-boundary mutation: adding "normal preflight gate" reds templates/routing/next.skeleton.md
...
V3 total failures: 72
```
72 = 8 files x 9 tokens, exactly the expected cardinality. The mutation loop fires on every pair;
none of it is vacuous.

Mirror deleted after use. `git diff --stat` confirms my change touches only
`scripts/test-route-reachability.js` (+7/-1); the other entries in the worktree diff belong to the
concurrent agents (`install.sh`, `test-generate-routing-surfaces.js`, `test-opencode-edition.js`).
